build_jax_snapshotter: build a JAXSnapshotter worker that periodically saves JAX models as TensorFlow SavedModels to a directory
run_snapshotter_worker: run the JAXSnapshotter worker to continuously snapshot models every 5 minutes with SIGTERM handling
convert_jax_to_tf_module: convert a JAX model with parameters and dummy kwargs into a TensorFlow tf.Module using jax2tf
snapshot_single_model: snapshot a single JAX model by converting it to a TF module and saving via tf.saved_model
configure_snapshot_retention: configure the JAXSnapshotter with max_to_keep to automatically delete excess old snapshots
